verdict.rationale: incident.io documents Workflows that act automatically on incident events, such as auto-publishing to the status page when an incident is updated. It also documents Investigations, an AI agent that starts the moment an incident is declared and keeps re-assessing as new signals arrive, plus integration automations like auto-creating incidents from Datadog monitors and two-way ticket sync. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the Workflows builder itself (triggers, conditions, actions, scheduling), user-defined custom agent automations beyond the built-in Investigations, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
